name: Northstar
tagline: Detects a fall on the trail, triages offline with an on-device model and reads vital signs through the phone camera.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: Many hiking injuries are falls, and trails often lack data coverage for getting help.
solution: Accelerometer fall detection triggers voice triage on an on-device model via ZETIC Melange, photoplethysmography estimates heart rate from the camera and flash, and Fetch.ai agents find the nearest care.
demo_moment: Team-described: simulate a fall, speak to the offline triage and take a camera pulse reading.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” and “Zetic Company Challenge” among 307 submissions.
Works where it is needed most: without a connection.
Won both the Agentverse and on-device AI prizes.

lessons: Design for the place the user actually is; offline is the feature.
